entities.name: Omnath
entities.description: A divine manifestation of Zendikar's wild and chaotic mana, an elemental being of pure mana.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane whose mana Omnath embodies.

entities.name: Prison of Omnath
entities.description: A site on a high mesa in Ondu safeguarded by a binding circle.

entities.name: Ritual of Lights
entities.description: A twice-yearly ceremony to prevent Omnath's release.

entities.name: Rise of the Eldrazi
entities.description: Events during which the ritual was disrupted.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Omnath was compleated.

entities.name: Kor Empire
entities.description: In the Echoverse, tried to trap Omnath in a Skyclave prison.

events.summary: The Ritual of Lights is disrupted during the events leading up to the Rise of the Eldrazi and Omnath is set loose.
events.quote: the ritual was disrupted and Omnath was set loose

events.summary: Omnath is compleated as part of the New Phyrexian Invasion, gaining black mana.
events.quote: Omnath was compleated as part of the New Phyrexian Invasion

events.summary: In the Echoverse, Omnath eats through its last bindings after a century of imprisonment.
events.quote: Omnath ate through the last of its bindings and freely roamed the plane once more
